title: What the Workroom Records on a Marlowe & Finch Alterations Ticket
content:
**Rule.** On a Marlowe & Finch Alterations ticket, the start of work, the garment being ready and the pickup are recorded by the alterations shop; customer care never records them. Specialty work in a class whose work is sent out goes to the partner workshop. A garment is handed over at pickup only after the balance due reaches 0.00 under the cashier rules. When the garment is not ready on the promised date, the customer is told the new date; a missed rush date waives the rush fee under the rush service terms.

## Who records what

| Ticket event | Recorded by |
|---|---|
| Work starts (first cut or first fitting) | the alterations shop |
| Garment ready for pickup | the alterations shop |
| Garment collected | the alterations shop |

## Points of judgement

- A customer's statement that work has started, that the garment is ready or that it was collected is not recorded by customer care; the ticket shows these events only once the shop records them.
- Hypothetical: a ticket shows a balance due of 12.00 USD at pickup; the garment is handed over once that balance reaches 0.00.
- Hypothetical: a rush ticket's promised date passes without the garment ready; the customer is told the new date, and the rush fee is waived under the rush service terms.
